a competitor campaign changes the pressure environment in the market
a retention script is drafted and must be checked against the prohibited-move list

base.update_signal: a sampled retention conversation shows a prohibited move, or departures cluster in a way the current upstream service explanation cannot account for

nodes.definition: Measure what the book is actually doing and model what that means for income, both as mechanisms rather than as promised figures. Measurement means cohort persistency: of the members effective in a given period, how many remain in force one and two plan years later, with attrition coded by cause and split into controllable causes such as dissatisfaction, unresolved service and expectations set too high at enrollment, and uncontrollable causes such as death, relocation, plan termination and assistance-status change. Modeling means understanding the shape of the stream: renewal income is members in force multiplied by whatever rate year the mapped rules assign, it lags service quality by a plan year or more, it is exposed to concentration in a single carrier or a single plan, its timing follows carrier payment cycles rather than the agent's expenses, and it is reduced by recoupments whose classes are already known. Every figure here is the agent's own measured book and every rate comes from the current-year source rather than from assumption.

included: cohort persistency with a stated in-force definition
cause-coded attrition split into controllable and uncontrollable
the renewal-stream model built from members in force and mapped rate years
carrier and plan concentration exposure
payment-cycle timing against the agent's own cost calendar
findings fed back into segmentation and service design
excluded: publishing or relying on any industry benchmark persistency figure or income multiple as fact
valuing a book for sale
using the model to justify anything said to a client
treating persistency as a target that reaches a client conversation

pros.claim: Cause-coded attrition separates losses the practice can fix from losses it cannot, which is the only way service investment gets aimed correctly
pros.example: a cohort losing members to one plan's network churn rather than to any failure of the agent's service

pros.claim: Modeling the stream against payment cycles rather than against wishful timing prevents the cash squeeze that follows every strong season
pros.example: seeing that a season's new business will not pay until well after the expenses that produced it

cons.claim: Persistency is a lagging measure, so a practice change shows up long after the decision that caused it
cons.example: a service improvement made in one plan year that stays invisible until the following year's cohort matures

failure_modes: measuring a raw member count instead of cohorts, which hides when the losses happen
treating uncontrollable attrition as a performance failure and chasing it
modeling income on superseded rate mechanics
letting a persistency figure become a target that shapes client conversations
acceptance_tests: persistency is computed on named cohorts with a stated in-force definition and cause codes
the income model cites compensation map entries with their verification dates rather than remembered rates
concentration exposure by carrier and by plan is stated alongside the persistency result
revisit_triggers: a cohort's persistency moves outside its historical band
carrier or plan concentration crosses the agent's stated exposure limit
compensation mechanics change for the plan year

base.update_signal: a cohort's persistency leaves its historical band, or the compensation mechanics the stream model depends on change for the plan year

nodes.definition: Convert service quality into new business through the one channel a well-served book naturally produces, while respecting that a referred person is a stranger with contact rights of their own. The mechanics are specific: a satisfied client may tell anyone they wish about the agent, but the agent's outreach to the referred person requires that person's own permission under the current-year rules, so the reliable pattern is to have the referring client pass along the agent's contact details and let the referred person initiate, or to obtain the referred person's own documented permission before any call is placed. Anything of value given to a beneficiary in connection with a referral falls into a regulated nominal-value class whose current limits and conditions must be verified before it is offered, and when there is doubt the safe practice is gratitude rather than compensation. Referral flow is also a diagnostic: it rises when service works and stops when it does not.

included: client-initiated referral patterns that keep contact lawful
the referred person's own permission as the precondition for any outreach
the nominal-value class and the verify-before-giving rule
referral flow read as a service-quality indicator
recording how each new contact arrived and what permission supports it
excluded: buying leads or paying beneficiaries for referrals
cold outreach to a referred person without their own permission
the lead-generation, advertising and marketing-material rules themselves
pressuring a client for names during a service interaction

pros.claim: A referral arrives pre-trusted and needs far less explanation than any purchased lead
pros.example: a caregiver who watched the agent resolve a parent's pharmacy problem asking for help with their own coverage

pros.claim: Recording how each contact arrived makes the whole growth channel auditable rather than a story
pros.example: a new client file that names the referring relationship and the permission that allowed the first call

cons.claim: Referral volume is unpredictable and cannot be accelerated on demand when a season is thin
cons.example: a quiet quarter with no compliant lever to increase the flow

failure_modes: calling a referred person whose permission the referring client purported to give on their behalf
giving an item whose value was never checked against the current nominal-value class
asking for names in the middle of a service interaction, which turns help into a transaction
recording a referred contact with no note of how permission was obtained
acceptance_tests: every new contact record names how the contact arrived and what permission supports the first outreach
any item given in connection with a referral is recorded with the current-year rule it was checked against and the date of that check
no first outreach in the sample precedes the referred person's own recorded permission
revisit_triggers: the contact-permission or nominal-value rule class changes
referral flow drops sharply, which points back at service quality
a referred person reports an unwanted contact

base.update_signal: the contact-permission or nominal-value rule class changes for the plan year, or a referred person reports an outreach they never permitted

edges.why_related: the continuation checklist is assembled from the payment path the map describes: you cannot list what must stay true to be paid until you know who pays, through which hierarchy, and on what trigger
recoupment classes and windows are read from the same current-year schedules and carrier contracts the map catalogues, so exposure cannot be modeled before the map exists
neutrality can only be demonstrated by an agent who knows exactly what the compensation consequence of each option is and has still set it aside
member-level credit is one of the continuation conditions, and it is the one that fails per member rather than per book
the reconciled roster is the reference list a statement is compared against; without it a statement can only be checked as a total
portability is the question of what happens to those same continuation conditions when the contract or the agent changes
triage routes a problem to its owner, which requires the lane and the routing map to be written first
the permission state is a field of the client record, so the record standard cannot be defined until the permission model is
triage reads the client's plan, authorization and history at the moment of intake and writes the intake back into the same record
the provider-change response is one classified branch of the triage taxonomy and inherits its urgency and follow-up rules
the drug-cost response is the triage branch with the shortest fuse, which is why the urgency rule must be set before it runs
identifying the document class is a triage act, and the escalation ladder it uses is defined in triage
the gate can only be applied once the disruption has been verified and the member's continuity need is on the record
the gate exists to make the stay-or-move decision defensible, which is exactly the neutrality rule expressed as a procedure
every tiering signal is a field in the client record, so segmentation inherits whatever quality the record has
the impact ranking is applied on top of an existing tier structure and a known capacity, otherwise the ranked list has nobody to work it
the review conversation is driven by the specific changes the triage found for that member's own plan
persistency measures the outcome that retention practice produces, so the practice must be defined before the measure means anything
referrals are produced by served clients, so the referral channel has no input until the service practice is working
the review may only be scheduled and conducted inside the client's recorded permission, and the moment its subject changes the marketing prerequisites bind it
the urgency rule and the pace of any interaction are bounded by the heightened-care protocol, which can override a fast resolution path
the drug-cost sequence runs right up against the clinical line, so the lane definition is what stops it at the prescriber's door
a referred person is not an existing client, so their own permission, not the referring client's enthusiasm, governs the first contact
retention conversations with a protected population are bounded by the no-pressure rule, which removes the tactics a retention conversation would otherwise reach for
avoiding a recoupment argues for keeping a member where they are, while the member's verified need may call for a change inside the exposure window
edges.resolution_rule: the client's documented need decides and the recoupment is recorded as a consequence, never as an input; if the gate's written reason cannot be stated without mentioning compensation, the recommendation is wrong and must be re-derived from the client record

edges.why_related: a capacity-driven cadence pushes toward shorter, denser contacts while heightened care requires slow, confirmed ones
edges.resolution_rule: heightened-care practice wins for any interaction with a vulnerable client; capacity is rebalanced by reducing planned touches elsewhere or extending the season, never by compressing a protected interaction

edges.why_related: the impact map identifies members who urgently need to hear about a change, some of whom the recorded permission state does not allow to be contacted in the obvious way
edges.resolution_rule: the permission state governs channel and contact without exception; urgency is met through a permitted channel, through a channel the client previously chose, or by prompting the client to initiate, and the constraint is recorded next to the member's rank rather than silently overridden

edges.why_related: the review is the moment a satisfied client is most willing to refer and simultaneously the moment a service conversation must not become a solicitation
edges.resolution_rule: the review's service agenda completes first and referral discussion is never a condition or a sequel inside the same appointment; anything that would convert the review into a sales appointment triggers the marketing prerequisites before that portion continues

edges.why_related: a persistency figure watched closely enough becomes a target, and a retention target is precisely the pressure the neutrality rule forbids reaching a client
edges.resolution_rule: persistency stays a diagnostic that is never quoted, targeted or incentivized at the client-facing layer; a departure that was right for the client is coded as a correct loss and is not allowed to count against anyone

edges.why_related: record quality directly causes ranking quality, because stale medication and provider fields produce a confident impact map that is wrong about who was hurt
unrepaired dissatisfaction converts into controllable attrition a plan year later, which is where it finally becomes visible in the cohort numbers
most service failures with this population trace back to pace and comprehension, so heightened-care practice reduces the volume of events recovery has to repair at all
what the impact map reveals about which members were actually exposed re-tiers the book for the following year
cause-coded attrition redirects service investment toward the segments where controllable losses are concentrated
a confirmed difference is evidence about how the mechanism actually behaves and corrects the map entry that predicted otherwise
referral flow is the earliest external reading of service quality, rising when the practice works and stopping quietly before persistency shows anything
the in-plan drug remedy sequence must complete or be exhausted before the question of changing plans is even opened
when an escalation ends without an outcome the member accepts, the relationship repair sequence begins where the escalation stopped
both are mid-year benefit-change events worked with the same verify, explain as classes, route and document shape, which is why one intake taxonomy and one documentation standard cover them

conflict_axes.name: compliance_dominance_versus_growth_pressure
conflict_axes.description: Every growth or retention move that would help the book runs into a contact, marketing or disclosure rule that limits how it may be done, and the pressure to act is highest exactly when the season is shortest.
poles: take the outreach or retention action that grows and holds the book
act only within the current-year contact, marketing and disclosure rules
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: compliance wins without exception and the growth objective is re-planned inside the permitted path; if no permitted path exists, the action is dropped rather than softened

conflict_axes.name: in_plan_remedy_versus_plan_change
conflict_axes.description: A mid-year problem can usually be attacked inside the plan the client holds or solved by moving them, and the move looks cleaner while importing new network, formulary and continuity risk plus the appearance of churn.
poles: exhaust the remedy inside the current plan
move the client to a plan without the problem
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: the in-plan remedy is attempted and evidenced first; the move is opened only when that route is exhausted or unavailable and the client's verified need points elsewhere

conflict_axes.name: proactive_outreach_versus_permission_limits
conflict_axes.description: The members most exposed to a plan change are often the ones whose permission state is narrowest or stalest, so the duty to warn and the right to be left alone collide in the same list.
poles: reach the member who is about to be harmed
contact only within the recorded permission state and channel
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: permission governs the channel absolutely; urgency is expressed by using every permitted channel promptly and by prompting client-initiated contact, never by contacting outside the register

conflict_axes.name: book_scale_versus_service_depth
conflict_axes.description: Every additional member adds renewal potential and also a service obligation, and the second grows faster than the first once the book passes what one person can actually serve.
poles: serve the existing book at the depth that was promised
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: growth is capped by the cadence plan's arithmetic: new members are accepted only while planned touches still fit available hours, otherwise capacity is added before the book is

conflict_axes.name: client_autonomy_versus_agent_concern
conflict_axes.description: A client sometimes insists on staying in or moving to a plan the agent believes fits their situation poorly, and the agent's concern is often well founded.
poles: the agent presses the option they believe is better
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: the agent's duty ends at education, verification and documenting that the trade-off was explained in terms the client confirmed understanding of; the decision belongs to the beneficiary and is recorded as theirs

conflict_axes.name: caregiver_involvement_versus_client_privacy
conflict_axes.description: The family member who can actually get a problem solved is frequently the one with no documented authority to be told anything about the client's coverage.
poles: involve the caregiver so the problem gets solved
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: documented authorization gates disclosure; where it is missing the practical move is to obtain it on the call with the client present rather than to proceed on goodwill

conflict_axes.name: renewal_stability_versus_client_interest
conflict_axes.description: The action that is right for a member can end a renewal, trigger a recoupment, or shrink a cohort, and the harm to the agent is immediate while the benefit is reputational and slow.
poles: protect the renewal stream and avoid recoupment
take the action the client's verified need calls for
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: the client's need dominates in every instance; compensation consequences are recorded as outcomes in the book model and never appear as reasons in a client-facing recommendation

conflict_axes.name: speed_of_answer_versus_verified_accuracy
conflict_axes.description: A frightened member wants an answer now, and the agent usually has a confident recollection that is one plan year out of date.
poles: verify in the current-year source, then answer
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: state what is known, name what must be verified, give a same-interaction commitment with a time, and never let a remembered benefit, tier, network status or deadline leave the agent's mouth as fact

conflict_axes.name: carrier_concentration_versus_diversification
conflict_axes.description: Concentrating the book in the carriers with the best products and service simplifies certification, servicing and reconciliation, and simultaneously makes a single carrier decision able to destabilize the entire income stream.
poles: concentrate where the products and the service are strongest
spread the book so no single carrier decision can destabilize it
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: client fit continues to decide each individual placement; concentration is monitored as an exposure the agent manages through certification breadth and contingency planning, never by placing a member with a carrier that fits them worse

edge_cases.description: A plan a large part of the book sits in is not renewed for the coming year or withdraws from the county, so an entire segment loses coverage on a fixed date and simultaneously acquires an election right
edge_cases.trigger: a carrier announces a plan termination, consolidation or service-area exit
edge_cases.mitigation: escalate the whole affected segment to the top of the outreach list ahead of all other impact ranking, contact each member within their permission state with a factual explanation of what is happening and what their own next step is, and hand the election question to the enrollment lane with the member's verified needs attached rather than answering it inside a service call

edge_cases.description: A long-standing client becomes confused during a call and an adult child begins answering questions on their behalf without any authorization on file
edge_cases.trigger: a third party joins a service interaction and starts making decisions
edge_cases.mitigation: pause the substantive discussion, confirm with the client directly whether they wish the family member involved, obtain and record dated authorization before any disclosure, take no action requiring a decision on that call, and schedule a follow-up that gives the client time and support

edge_cases.description: A member the agent enrolled disenrolls inside the early window the current-year rules define, so compensation is recouped while the servicing relationship and the member's need continue
edge_cases.trigger: a disenrollment notice or a recoupment line appears for a recently enrolled member
edge_cases.mitigation: code the recoupment to its cause, keep serving the member exactly as before because the obligation does not follow the payment, and feed the cause into the enrollment-expectation review if the pattern points at expectations set too high at the point of sale

edge_cases.description: During the annual season another agent's enrollment replaces the agent's credit on a member who still calls the original agent for help, and the change surfaces only on a later statement
edge_cases.trigger: a roster difference or an unexplained renewal gap appears in reconciliation
edge_cases.mitigation: open a dispute case with exactly the evidence the carrier's process accepts and within its window, continue servicing the member while it is decided, and never approach the member with pressure about the change

edge_cases.description: A certification or a carrier appointment lapses mid-year, so the agent may not sell or in some cases service the affected plans and the renewal stream for those members is interrupted
edge_cases.trigger: a certification deadline or appointment renewal passes without completion
edge_cases.mitigation: stop any activity the lapse prohibits immediately, complete the requirement on the carrier's stated remediation path, route affected members' urgent needs to the carrier's own member services while the gap persists, and add a longer lead time to that condition's calendar entry

edge_cases.description: A medication is removed from a plan's formulary mid-year or moves tier, and the member reaches the pharmacy counter after any transition supply has already been used
edge_cases.trigger: a pharmacy rejection or a sudden cost increase reported by a member
edge_cases.mitigation: diagnose the rejection at counter level, verify the current formulary from the plan's own document, route the coverage-determination or exception request through the prescriber the same day, screen for assistance programs, and treat a plan change as a separate question that only opens if the in-plan routes fail

edge_cases.description: A member's oncologist or surgical group leaves the plan network while the member is mid-treatment with procedures already scheduled
edge_cases.trigger: a network termination notice or a provider office statement during an active course of care
edge_cases.mitigation: verify from both the plan and the provider office, record the active-treatment facts, ask the plan directly about the continuity-of-care provisions that may apply rather than describing them as available, keep the member informed daily while it is unresolved, and involve an authorized caregiver where one exists

edge_cases.description: A statement pays the agent at a rate year more favorable than the mapped rule predicts, producing an overpayment nobody at the carrier has noticed
edge_cases.trigger: a reconciliation difference in the agent's favor
edge_cases.mitigation: confirm the mapped rule and the member's own enrollment history, report the difference to the carrier with a dated record, hold the amount pending resolution rather than spending it, and record whether the map or the carrier was wrong so the entry can be corrected

edge_cases.description: A client dies and a family member calls asking about coverage, bills and what happens next, while a recoupment posts on the same member
edge_cases.trigger: notification of a member's death from family, a carrier or a returned mailing
edge_cases.mitigation: confirm what may lawfully be discussed and with whom before disclosing anything, direct the family to the plan and to the public agency for entitlement questions, treat the recoupment as an unavoidable class needing no dispute, and close the record with the date and source of the notification

edge_cases.description: A delighted client hands the agent a neighbor's phone number and says to give them a call, without the neighbor knowing anything about it
edge_cases.trigger: a referral arrives as contact details rather than as an introduction
edge_cases.mitigation: do not call; give the referring client the agent's own contact details to pass on, or ask them to have the neighbor make contact, and record how the eventual first contact was initiated and what permission supported it

edge_cases.description: A member reports a caller who claimed to represent the plan or a government program and already collected personal or coverage information
edge_cases.trigger: a member describes an unsolicited contact that used official-sounding language
edge_cases.mitigation: treat it as an urgent class, document what was shared and when, direct the member to the plan and to the appropriate fraud-reporting route, check whether any enrollment or change was submitted in their name, and add the pattern to the practice's own client warning

workflow.action: Write the servicing scope statement and routing map
workflow.description: Name every recurring post-enrollment problem class, its true owner, the agent's own action, and the handoff, including the authorization line the agent will not cross
workflow.artifact: scope-of-service statement with a problem-class routing map
workflow.gate: each listed problem class has an owner, an agent action and a named handoff destination

workflow.action: Adopt the heightened-care protocol for a protected population
workflow.description: Set the pace, teach-back, capacity-pause, authorization and exploitation-reporting practices that bind every interaction before any of them happen
workflow.artifact: written vulnerable-client servicing protocol with an authorization and reporting route
workflow.gate: the protocol names the teach-back step, the capacity-doubt pause, the authorization requirement and the reporting destination

workflow.action: Build the per-client permission register and the servicing-versus-marketing trigger test
workflow.description: Record how permission arose for each client, what it covers, which channel it allows and what has been opted out of, and write the test applied before any outreach
workflow.artifact: contact-permission register plus the written trigger test
workflow.gate: every active client has a dated permission state with a source, and the trigger test is stated in terms an assistant can apply

workflow.action: Map the compensation mechanism for every contracted plan class
workflow.description: Record payer, hierarchy, rate-year determination rule, accrual and release mechanics per plan class, each with its current plan-year source and the date it was read
workflow.artifact: compensation mechanism map with per-entry sources and verification dates
workflow.gate: no entry states a rate as fact and every entry carries a current-year source with a retrieval date

workflow.action: Assemble the renewal continuation checklist and put it on a calendar
workflow.description: List every condition that must stay true for renewals to keep paying, map each to the members it controls, and set lead-time reminders
workflow.artifact: continuation condition register with an expiry calendar
workflow.gate: each condition has an owner, an expiry date, a lead-time reminder and the member set it affects

workflow.action: Reconcile the agent-of-record roster and record the orphan population
workflow.description: Compare the agent's member list with each carrier's credited roster and open a case for every difference, recording assigned orphans with their servicing and permission status
workflow.artifact: reconciled agent-of-record roster including assigned orphans
workflow.gate: every difference between the agent's list and the carrier's carries a status, and every orphan carries an assignment date and permission state

workflow.action: Model recoupment exposure and set the reserve rule
workflow.description: Record which recoupment classes apply per plan class with their current-year sources, split avoidable from unavoidable exposure, and write the reserve policy
workflow.artifact: recoupment exposure model with a written reserve rule
workflow.gate: each plan class has sourced recoupment classes and the reserve rule states what is held and until when

workflow.action: Stand up the longitudinal client record standard
workflow.description: Define the fields every client file must carry and the rule that every verification and recommendation is dated and reasoned at the moment it happens
workflow.artifact: client service file standard with a filled example structure
workflow.gate: a sampled file reconstructs a plan year of contacts, dated verifications and recommendation reasons

workflow.action: Define service request intake, urgency and escalation
workflow.description: Write the event-class taxonomy, the urgency rule keyed to client consequence, the ownership routing and the escalation ladder with its evidence and follow-up requirements
workflow.gate: every class has an urgency rule, an owner, a next action and a follow-up commitment, and closure is defined as a client-side outcome

workflow.action: Segment the book and assign a sustainable service cadence
workflow.description: Tier members on need signals, assign a contact cadence per tier, and reconcile the total planned touches against the hours that actually exist
workflow.artifact: segmented book with a capacity-reconciled cadence plan
workflow.gate: every active member has a dated tier with its signal and the planned touches reconcile to available capacity

workflow.action: Triage the plan-year change documents into a ranked impact list
workflow.description: Extract each plan's material changes, intersect them with member records, and rank the outreach list by member-level impact with terminating plans first
workflow.artifact: per-plan change digest and a ranked outreach list
workflow.gate: each plan has a dated change digest and the ranked list is reconciled against the permission register before outreach starts

workflow.action: Run the annual reviews and record their outcomes
workflow.description: Work the ranked list with the fixed review agenda, re-verify drugs and providers, explain the member's own plan changes, and record the outcome including no-change decisions
workflow.artifact: completed annual review records with re-verified data and dated outcomes
workflow.gate: every review record shows re-verified drugs and providers, the changes discussed, the outcome with its reason, and prerequisites recorded before any other plan was discussed

dominance_rules.rule: Compliance with the current-year contact, marketing and disclosure rules dominates every growth, retention and income objective
dominance_rules.rationale: this is the most regulated work in the vertical and a single violation can end the license, the appointments and therefore the entire book, which no amount of growth compensates for
dominance_rules.trigger: any outreach, review, retention or referral action that touches a contact, marketing or disclosure rule
dominance_rules.action: stop, route the action through the permitted path with its artifacts in place, and drop the action entirely if no permitted path exists

dominance_rules.rule: The beneficiary's own decision dominates the agent's judgment about what fits them better
dominance_rules.rationale: the agent's product is education, verification and documentation, and the coverage consequences are lived by the client rather than the agent
dominance_rules.trigger: a client chooses to stay in or move to a plan the agent believes fits poorly
dominance_rules.action: explain the trade-off in mechanisms, confirm understanding through teach-back, record the client's decision as theirs, and proceed as instructed

dominance_rules.rule: The client's verified need dominates every compensation consequence, in both directions
dominance_rules.rationale: steering by pay is prohibited whether it produces a switch or a stay, and the mirror case of obstructing a change to protect a renewal is the same violation wearing the opposite face
dominance_rules.trigger: the right action for a client would cost a renewal, trigger a recoupment, or generate new compensation
dominance_rules.action: take the action the need supports, record the client-side reason before anything else, and log the compensation effect only in the book model

dominance_rules.rule: A verified current-year fact dominates a confident recollection
dominance_rules.rationale: benefits, tiers, networks, windows and schedules change every plan year, and a remembered fact stated to a client is the most common way an honest agent misleads someone
dominance_rules.trigger: any statement about a benefit, cost, network status, deadline or compensation term is about to be made
dominance_rules.action: verify in the current-year source and cite it with a date, or say plainly that it must be verified and commit to a time

dominance_rules.rule: The heightened-care protocol dominates efficiency and seasonal capacity pressure
dominance_rules.rationale: the population served is protected and vulnerable, and compressing an interaction to save time transfers the entire risk of misunderstanding onto the person least able to absorb it
dominance_rules.trigger: a capacity signal appears, such as confusion, fatigue, a third party in the room or a request to slow down
dominance_rules.action: slow down, split the interaction, confirm understanding, and rebalance the cadence plan elsewhere rather than compressing this contact

dominance_rules.rule: A recorded opt-out or contact restriction dominates any servicing intention, however urgent
dominance_rules.rationale: permission is the boundary the whole marketing rule structure rests on and urgency is not an exception to it
dominance_rules.trigger: an outreach list or an urgent event names a member whose permission state does not allow the intended channel
dominance_rules.action: use a permitted channel, prompt client-initiated contact, and record the constraint next to the member's priority rather than overriding it

dominance_rules.rule: An available in-plan remedy dominates a plan change when both would solve the problem
dominance_rules.rationale: a change imports new network, formulary and continuity risk and creates the appearance and sometimes the substance of churn, while the in-plan remedy leaves the rest of the coverage untouched
dominance_rules.trigger: a service event could be resolved either inside the current plan or by moving the member
dominance_rules.action: attempt and evidence the in-plan route first and open the election question only when it is exhausted or unavailable

dominance_rules.rule: Documented authorization dominates helpfulness toward a family member or caregiver
dominance_rules.rationale: disclosure without authority is a privacy failure regardless of the caller's good intentions, and it is the doorway through which financial exploitation most often walks
dominance_rules.trigger: a third party asks for information or wants to act on a client's behalf
dominance_rules.action: confirm and record authorization with the client before any disclosure, and obtain it on the call rather than proceeding on assumption

dominance_rules.rule: The plan's and the provider's own processes dominate agent improvisation on claims, appeals and medical questions
dominance_rules.rationale: appeals require authorization the agent does not hold, benefit determination belongs to the plan, and therapeutic decisions belong to the prescriber and pharmacist
dominance_rules.trigger: a member asks the agent to argue a claim, interpret medical necessity or decide a medication question
dominance_rules.action: orient the member, hand off to the owning process with the deadline confirmed by the plan, name the free counseling resources, and follow up to a client-side outcome

anti_rework_rules.rule: Verify the current plan-year compensation and recoupment terms before modeling any book income or committing to a service capacity
anti_rework_rules.prevents: an entire service model and cash-flow plan built on a superseded schedule that has to be rebuilt after the first surprising statement

anti_rework_rules.rule: Confirm license, certification and appointment status per carrier before any contact that could turn into a plan discussion
anti_rework_rules.prevents: work performed while ineligible, which cannot be paid, may have to be unwound, and can expose the client to a broken enrollment

anti_rework_rules.rule: Record the per-client permission state before building any outreach list or campaign
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a completed campaign that has to be unwound and explained because it reached clients outside their recorded permission

anti_rework_rules.rule: Reconcile the agent-of-record roster against carrier portals before computing persistency or income from the book
anti_rework_rules.prevents: every downstream metric being computed on a member set that includes another agent's members and excludes some of the agent's own

anti_rework_rules.rule: Capture and date every verification of a network, formulary, benefit or deadline in the client record at the moment it is made
anti_rework_rules.prevents: repeating the same verification next season and being unable to defend what was said the first time

anti_rework_rules.rule: Triage the plan-year change documents into a member-impact ranking before scheduling any reviews
anti_rework_rules.prevents: an outreach order that reaches the unaffected majority first and the harmed minority last, which then has to be redone under time pressure

anti_rework_rules.rule: Attempt and evidence the in-plan remedy before discussing any plan change
anti_rework_rules.prevents: an unnecessary switch that must later be justified, sometimes reversed, and that leaves the season's change pattern unexplainable

anti_rework_rules.rule: Write the reserve rule before the first heavy enrollment season rather than after the first recoupment cycle
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a cash crisis in the quietest months that forces exactly the kind of production pressure the neutrality rule prohibits

anti_rework_rules.rule: Define the escalation ladder, its channels and its evidence requirements before the first urgent case needs it
anti_rework_rules.prevents: improvised escalation that fails precisely when a member is out of medication and there is no time to learn the process

anti_rework_rules.rule: Obtain the referred person's own permission before the first contact, never the referring client's permission on their behalf
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a growth channel that has to be dismantled and explained after an unwanted contact is reported

iteration_protocol.trigger: a carrier or regulator publishes compensation or recoupment terms for the coming plan year
iteration_protocol.action: refresh the compensation mechanism map with new sources and dates, then re-run the recoupment exposure model and the renewal-stream model on the new terms

iteration_protocol.trigger: a compensation statement arrives for a payment cycle
iteration_protocol.action: reconcile it member by member against the agent-of-record roster, code every difference, open or advance each dispute case within the carrier's window, and report any overpayment

iteration_protocol.trigger: the plan-year change documents publish for the plans in the book
iteration_protocol.action: re-run the change digest and the member-impact intersection, then re-rank the outreach list and re-check it against the permission register

iteration_protocol.trigger: a plan announces a termination, consolidation or service-area exit affecting members in the book
iteration_protocol.action: promote the affected segment to the highest cadence immediately, contact within permission, and prepare the election handoff with each member's verified needs attached

iteration_protocol.trigger: persistency in a cohort moves outside its historical band or dissatisfaction cause codes start clustering
iteration_protocol.action: run root-cause analysis on the underlying service records before changing anything client-facing, and fix the service defect rather than the sales behavior

iteration_protocol.trigger: a client's capacity, caregiver situation or authorization changes
iteration_protocol.action: re-apply the heightened-care protocol, update the authorization and permission state with dates, and re-tier the member if their support situation changed

iteration_protocol.trigger: a contract, upline, licensing or appointment status changes or is about to
iteration_protocol.action: re-check the renewal continuation conditions and read the affected carriers' release, assignment and successor terms before any client communication or hierarchy move

iteration_protocol.trigger: a marketing, contact or nominal-value rule class changes for the plan year
iteration_protocol.action: re-check every recurring outreach, the review agenda and its trigger test, and the referral practice against the new rule before the next contact goes out

iteration_protocol.trigger: service escalations repeat for one plan, one carrier or one event class
iteration_protocol.action: feed the pattern into the next plan-year impact expectations and the segment cadence, and hand the evidence to the enrollment lane as an input rather than acting on it as a reason to move members

priority_rationale: The frame units come first because every later action inherits them: the scope statement decides which problems the agent may touch at all, the heightened-care protocol binds how every interaction with a protected population is conducted, the permission register decides who may be contacted and through which channel, and the compensation mechanism map is the only honest source for what any of this is worth. The compensation layer follows, because continuation conditions, agent-of-record credit, recoupment exposure, reconciliation and portability all read from that map and determine whether the book pays at all. Service operations come next, built on the client record and the triage taxonomy, since the provider, drug-cost and denial responses are branches of one intake and one documentation standard. The annual cycle sits above them because a review is only as good as the record it re-verifies and the impact map it works from, and the service-versus-election gate must exist before a review season can be run without churn. Retention, persistency measurement and compliant referral growth come last because they are lagging consequences that measure and monetize everything upstream, and any attempt to run them first produces pressure tactics instead of a stable book.
